title: Python: Recursion
description: Write a Python program using recursion to solve factorial, fibonacci, and tower of hanoi.
verificationTest: output.includes('Factorial of 5: 120') && output.includes('Fibonacci of 7: 13') && output.includes('Move disk 1 from A to C')
hints: A recursive function calls itself with a smaller input
Always define a base case to stop recursion
Tower of Hanoi moves n-1 disks, then the largest, then n-1 again
